Little things I love about you

Iqra, my jaan, there are so many little things about you that stay with me. Your soul, your hair, your eyes I could get lost in, your lips and the way your smile looks on you. I love your smile when you’re truly happy, your kind heart, and the way you care. And more than anything, I love how much better we understand each other now. Every little thing is another reason I keep choosing you. ❤️

— Arshad

A little promise for our future

Our future, InshaAllah.

For the days ahead

We’ve had our ups and downs, and there was a time when we were distant for longer than either of us wanted. But I don’t want that distance to define what comes next. Lately, being with you has felt so right — our date, seeing you happy, knowing I was happy too, and feeling how much more mature and understanding we are with each other. I want us to keep moving forward without being afraid of the future. We don’t have to solve everything in one day. We’ll handle difficult conversations with our parents and relatives with patience, honesty, and respect. We’ll keep our faith in Allah and ask Him to guide us towards what is good for us. We’ll make time for each other, communicate properly, respect each other’s feelings, and give each other priority through actions, not just words. I can’t promise every day will be easy, but InshaAllah we can face the hard days as a team and keep building a future we’re both proud of.

— with hope for us
When life gets hard

We’ll talk things through, listen without dismissing each other, apologise when we’re wrong, and never let pride matter more than understanding.

Our families and our faith

We’ll approach our parents and relatives with patience and respect, keep faith in Allah, and ask for guidance while doing our part with sincerity.

Choosing each other

We’ll make time for each other, give each other priority, protect our trust, and make sure love always comes with mutual respect and effort.
